description: This file defines the interface WidgetsBundleDao, which provides data access methods for WidgetsBundle entities, including saving, finding by tenant ID and alias, and retrieving system or tenant widget bundles with pagination.

classes.name: WidgetsBundleDao
classes.description: Interface for data access operations related to WidgetsBundle entities, including CRUD and query methods with filtering and pagination.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves or updates a WidgetsBundle object for a specific tenant.

methods.name: findWidgetsBundleByTenantIdAndAlias
methods.description: Retrieves a WidgetsBundle by tenant UUID and alias.

methods.name: findSystemWidgetsBundles
methods.description: Finds system widgets bundles based on filter and pagination.

methods.name: findTenantWidgetsBundlesByTenantId
methods.description: Finds tenant-specific widgets bundles by tenant UUID with pagination.

methods.name: findAllTenantWidgetsBundlesByTenantId
methods.description: Finds all tenant widgets bundles including system ones, filtered and paginated.

methods.name: findTenantWidgetsBundlesByTenantId
methods.description: Finds tenant widgets bundles excluding system ones, filtered and paginated.

methods.name: findAllWidgetsBundles
methods.description: Retrieves all widget bundles with pagination.

methods.name: findSystemOrTenantWidgetBundlesByIds
methods.description: Finds widget bundles by tenant ID and list of widget bundle IDs.
